question: Who among the following were awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2020 for their exemplary work in genome editing?

options.text: George P Smith and Sir Gregory P Winter
James P Allison and Tasuku Honjo
Jennifer A Doudna and Emmanuelle Charpentier

solution:
The correct answer is __**Jennifer A Doudna and Emmanuelle Charpentier.**__

__
 
• **Jennifer A Doudna and Emmanuelle Charpentier were awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2020 for their exemplary work in genome editing**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

__
 
• Genome editing is the technology that allows the addition, alteration and removal of genetic material at particular locations in the genome.
 
• Specific changes in the DNA of a cell or organism are made.
 
• **Clustered Regularly Interspaced Short Palindromic Repeats(CRISPR)** technology is a gene-editing technology that can be used for the purpose of changing the genome of an Organism.
 
• French American Duo was awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2020 for the chemistry of CRISPR.
 
• **Cas9** is a special protein known as a genetic scissor which is used to break and remove the problematic sequence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
